faq: Will you fix the problems you find?
The audit is a report, not a repair. Many clients then order a fix package or send the list to their own developer. Either way the report is yours to keep and use.
Do you need access to my store?
Staff access with read permissions is enough for most checks. We never change anything during an audit and we never ask for your password.
How is this different from a free site scan?
Automated scans list technical flags. We look at the store as a buyer would, explain which issues cost you sales, and put them in order, so you know what to fix first.
What if I am new to BigCommerce?
That is fine. The report uses everyday words, and the call, if you add it, is a good place to ask questions about how your store is set up.
